name: Milestone Hotel
positioning: The Milestone Hotel & Residences, a Red Carnation hotel in a Grade II listed Victorian building directly opposite Kensington Palace, with individually decorated rooms, suites and residences
best_for: Travelers who want a Kensington base opposite Kensington Palace and its gardens
Families who want residences with full kitchens or a Family Suite with bunk beds
Suite guests who enjoy in-room extras such as private music performances

facts.text: The hotel sits directly opposite Kensington Palace, with views across the gardens to the palace.
The hotel is part of The Red Carnation Hotel Collection.
The hotel is in a Grade II listed Victorian building with a Kensington-style red and white brick facade.
No two rooms or suites are alike; rooms are decorated with fine fabrics, fresh flowers, antique furnishings and rare artworks.
The Hermès Suite is a Grand Master Suite with a four-poster bed and a collection of Hermès scarves.
The Residences have two or three bedrooms, fully equipped kitchens and private access through their own front door.
Cheneston's restaurant serves modern British cuisine.
Traditional British afternoon tea is served in The Park Lounge.
The Stables Bar has dark wood panelling, leather and tartan furnishings, and sporting artwork by Belgian artist Elie Lambert.
The Hideaway, a candlelit, dark wood-panelled room next to the Stables Bar, hosts private events and casual walk-ins.
The wellness area has a resistance pool, a cold plunge and an infrared sauna, plus a wellness studio for training.
The Natural History Museum and the Science Museum are nearby.

highlights.text: The Stables Bar once housed the building's horses.
The Oratory, the hotel's original chapel, is used for intimate private dining.
Suite guests can book in-room private performances by a Royal Philharmonic Orchestra solo harpist or a string trio.

Through a partnership with Historic Royal Palaces, hotel guests can get a limited allocation of complimentary tickets to the Tower of London, Hampton Court Palace and Kensington Palace, subject to availability.
The Family Suite has a children's retreat with bespoke bunk beds and hand-painted celestial details.

considerations.text: Interconnecting and interleading rooms must be booked directly through the hotel's reservations team.
The Palace Picnic in Kensington Gardens runs from spring to autumn only and needs 48 hours' notice.
WhataHotel notes limited parking availability in this central London location.
